variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables act as pointers to storage. To access the value, you use the fetch operator (.).

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
! BLISS is typeless.
! Everything is a machine word.
data_types.notes: BLISS is a typeless systems programming language. Data is simply treated as machine words.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Fetch operator '.' retrieves value. '=' is for assignment. Relational operators are alphabetic (EQL, LSS, GTR).

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
IF .X GTR 0 THEN
  Y = 1
ELSE
  Y = -1;
conditionals.notes: Since BLISS is expression-based, the IF statement evaluates to the value of the executed branch.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.code:
INCR I FROM 1 TO 10 DO
  SUM = .SUM + .I;
for_loop.notes: Uses INCR ... FROM ... TO ... DO syntax. DECR is used for decrementing loops.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are called ROUTINEs. The value of the last evaluated expression is implicitly returned.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are defined using BIND and data structure macros like VECTOR.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: No map data structures exist built-in. Implemented manually via memory structures.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code: ! Error handling done via return values.
error_handling.notes: No exceptions. Errors are handled through conditional checks and return codes.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: BLISS provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: BLISS supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: BLISS provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: BLISS converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: BLISS represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: BLISS formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: BLISS branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: BLISS defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: BLISS iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: BLISS organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: BLISS stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: BLISS groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: BLISS tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: BLISS organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
